hit.title: Introducing GPT-5.4 mini and nano
hit.body: GPT-5.4 mini and nano are smaller, faster versions of GPT-5.4 optimized for coding, tool use, multimodal reasoning, and high-volume API and sub-agent workloads.
hit.reason: New OpenAI models (GPT-5.4 mini and nano) require updating the model mapping table and competitive pricing analysis in the OpenAI-to-Bedrock migration guide.

step1.summary: OpenAI announced GPT-5.4 mini and nano as new smaller models, but the announcement lacks pricing information, while the file's entire value proposition rests on precise per-token pricing comparisons against Bedrock.
step1.old_value: GPT-5.4 Mini: $0.75/$4.50 per 1M (in/out); GPT-5.4 Nano: $0.20/$1.25 per 1M — both already listed in the file's GPT-5.4 Series table

step1.still_true: If these are simply confirming previously-released pricing, the existing GPT-5.4 Mini/Nano rows remain accurate; not confirmed either way.
